messages:
Tara (sales): SymphonyHealth POC seeing random SSE stream truncation on mobile. App reports malformed JSON when reconnecting. Can we triage?
Ethan (eng): Hosted API or dedicated? SDK or custom client? Any raw captures?
Tara (sales): Hosted. Using Redwood iOS/Android SDKs and a custom tiny web worker. They attached a short curl -v dump.
Mina (devex): Likely split multibyte UTF-8 across TCP frames or CDN buffering. Can you paste the raw chunk and headers when it fails?
Tara (sales): From app logs: "recv: "data: {\"note\": \"Ol"
"
And headers: x-request-id: sh-1122, x-rate-limit-remaining: 0, x-rate-limit-reset: 6
Carlos (solutions): That rate-limit header suggests reconnect bursts may be triggering 429s which then coincide with truncation. Two mitigations: reduce reconnect aggressiveness and add SSE keepalives from server.
Ethan (eng): Server fixes to try immediately: emit SSE comments every 10s (`:

`), call response flush after each event, set `X-Accel-Buffering: no` and `Cache-Control: no-transform`.
Mina (devex): Client short-term: buffer incoming bytes until you see the double newline delimiter before parsing. For UTF-8, use a streaming decoder that preserves partial code points. Also implement randomized backoff on reconnects to prevent stampede.
Tara (sales): Can infra spin up a temporary dedicated route to avoid CloudFront buffering for the POC? They want smooth UX.
infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-9302 for temporary dedicated ingress. Estimated provision time: 24-36h pending finance approval.
Carlos (solutions): I'll send a compact client snippet (Android/iOS) and a curl harness they can run. Also recommend toggling keepalive comments to see if it reduces truncation.
Tara (sales): Thanks, I'll push the snippets and the ask for a raw tcpdump if they can reproduce. Will post updates here.
